create_feature_extractor: create a VoxtralRealtimeFeatureExtractor with custom feature_size, sampling_rate, and hop_length parameters
extract_fbank_features: extract log-mel spectrogram features from raw audio waveform using PyTorch STFT with mel filter bank
featurize_raw_speech: featurize raw speech numpy array or list of floats into padded input_features BatchFeature tensor
build_mel_filter_bank: build mel filter bank with slaney norm and slaney mel scale for given frequency bins and sampling rate
process_batched_audio: process batched mono-channel audio arrays with padding, truncation, and attention mask generation
